text:
olivia_prod: :rotating_light: FYI customers are seeing 503s for multipart ingest (file uploads) in hosted-eu-west1, spike started ~6m ago. brief impact: upload/attach endpoints returning 503s intermittently (~3% of requests).
sre-alert-bot: Incident created: INC-2327 - multipart-ingest-503s. Pager routed to oncall.
matt_infra: I'm on it — starting with ingress proxy and multipart shard metrics. seeing increased queue depth on ingress-proxy-eu-3.
ana_support: multiple customers (3 enterprise, 7 dev) reported failing uploads. CS notified via status page draft. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2327
olivia_prod: Mitigation plan: 1) enable throttling on non-critical multipart endpoints 2) route heavy upload tenants to burst-dedicated path 3) scale multipart-worker pool + apply backpressure to ingest queue. doing 1 now.
matt_infra: Confirmed root cause: recent change to multipart windowing allowed larger parallel chunk counts; backend write fanout to embed-store increased and caused write saturation -> upstream 503s on attach flow. Rolling revert of the windowing change to canary 1/3.
ana_support: Customer comms: posted initial status with impact and ETA for mitigation. Will update after revert result.
olivia_prod: Revert rolled to canary, monitoring queue depth and p50/p99 attach latency. p99 attach latency down 42% in canary.
matt_infra: Increased worker replicas by +30% across eu-west workers; ingress-proxy throttle set to 120/s for anonymous uploads, 800/s for authenticated. Watch for retries.
rachel_cto: Thx team. Need a postmortem template capture: why change made without load test, what guardrails to add.
olivia_prod: Current status: mitigations applied, canary showing improvement, global rollout paused until validation. action items: (olivia) verify global rollback plan, (matt) add rate-limit telemetry dashboards, (rachel_cto) coordinate postmortem owner.
ana_support: CS note: customers with ongoing failures can request temporary dedicated upload queue — contact support for priority handoff.
sre-alert-bot: Update: INC-2327 status -> Mitigated (partial) at 2327005170. Monitoring for full recovery.
olivia_prod: Final update in this thread when we confirm full recovery. For now link to runbook and live dashboards: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/multipart-ingest and https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ingest/multipart-queues
